Field Note: Enter the PANORAMA case identifier exactly as shown in the filename

Field Label: Is this CT evaluable for PDAC annotation review?
Field Note: A CT is non-evaluable if the pancreas is absent from the field of view, slices are missing or corrupted, contrast phase is incorrect, or no tumor is visible despite the PDAC label.

Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, No pancreas in field of view | 2, Incomplete anatomical coverage (slices missing or truncated) | 3, Wrong contrast phase (non-contrast or arterial) | 4, Corrupted or unreadable file | 5, No visible tumor despite PDAC label | 6, Other (specify in notes) | 7, Stent | 8, Significant motion artifacts | 9, Significant streak artifacts
1, Complete (captures >=90% of radiologically apparent tumor) | 2, Partial (captures 50-89% of tumor) | 3, Grossly incomplete (captures < 50% of tumor) | 4, Over-segmented tumor
Field Note: Assess whether the PANORAMA-provided annotation captures the full radiologically apparent 3D tumor extent

Field Label: Estimated proportion of tumor volume captured by annotation

Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, Craniocaudal truncation (tumor extends above or below annotated slices) | 2, Lateral under-segmentation (annotation does not reach lateral tumor boundaries) | 3, Missed component (separate tumor focus or satellite not annotated) | 4, Over-segmentation (annotation substantially exceeds tumor boundaries)
Field Note: Select N/A if annotation is complete

Field Label: Is the CT of adequate quality for reliable volumetric tumor segmentation?
Field Note: Separate from annotation completeness. Assess the CT itself, not the annotation.

Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, Suboptimal contrast timing | 2, Other (specify in notes)
